name: Teckium Idle RPG
summary:
Teckium Idle RPG is a free fantasy role-playing game played in the web browser, built around expeditions in which your hero automatically fights streams of monsters while you collect loot, experience and crafting resources. The longer an expedition lasts, the higher its reward multiplier climbs, and dungeons with bosses, world bosses fought together by the whole community and a player-versus-player arena complete the combat.

Between fights, players craft and upgrade their gear at the workshop and the forge, hatch and raise elemental pets that fight at their side, join guilds and take part in a war between the Angel and Demon factions that shifts control of the world's zones. The game is in French and is closely tied to its Discord community.
